description_en: The distribution of scaling activities in different states over a period of time
description_zh: 统计一段时间内不同状态的伸缩活动分布
kebab_example: aliyun ess describe-scaling-activity-statistics --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --scaling-group-id asg-8vbje5pofxxxxxxxx --start-time 2025-12-15T08:00Z --end-time 2025-12-18T08:00Z --metric-type ScalingActivityStatus --api-version 2022-02-22 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeScalingActivityStatistics

parameters.help_en: The ID of the scaling group
parameters.name: scaling_group_id

parameters.help_en: The start time of the statistical interval. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and uses UTC time
parameters.help_zh: 统计区间开始时间，按照 ISO8601 标准表示，并需要使用 UTC 时间
parameters.name: start_time

parameters.help_en: The end time of the statistical interval. The time follows the ISO 8601 standard and uses UTC time
parameters.help_zh: 统计区间结束时间，按照 ISO8601 标准表示，并需要使用 UTC 时间
parameters.name: end_time

parameters.help_en:
The name of the metric on which the scaling activity is counted. Valid values:

ScalingActivityStatus: collects statistics on the distribution of scaling activities in different states within a time range.
ScalingActivityErrorCodes: the distribution of error codes in failed scaling activities within a time range.

Default value: ScalingActivityStatus
parameters.help_zh:
伸缩活动统计的指标名称，取值范围：

ScalingActivityStatus：统计区间内不同状态的伸缩活动分布。

ScalingActivityErrorCodes：统计区间内失败的伸缩活动中，不同错误码的分布。

默认值：ScalingActivityStatus
parameters.name: metric_type
